DPR-09: empty-draft first-item entry verified

Empty saved-null drafts now show the site catalogue without assigning a project merely for preview. Selecting the first real item activates validated automatic project recovery. No Site Work, Incidental-only, and other meaningful non-BOQ records remain protected. No manual project picker.

Evidence boundary: screenshots exercise real DPR controls with synthetic fixture APIs/browser storage. The fresh empty POST requested the already-resolved project; the fixture deliberately stored null to recreate the reported legacy state. Subsequent selection, save and cross-view reload used the same draft ID. This is not proof that the current production server creates null on a new empty save. Separate development PostgreSQL tests previously verified real null-to-positive persistence and server protections. No production/customer data was changed.

  • Browser regression passed with no exceptions.
  • Standard suite covered 3,379 tests: 3,305 passed in the combined run; three suites with 74 tests timed out at setup. All three, plus the worker-termination suite, passed on serial retry (104 tests).
  • Build passed. Focused code review passed.
  • No schema changes or publishing.
